event.title: Saudi Engineer Charged with Planting Listening Device at OpenAI Offices
event.canonical_title: Saudi Engineer Charged with Planting Listening Device at OpenAI Offices
event.summary: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi national and engineer at OpenAI, has been charged by the FBI for allegedly planting a hidden recording device in a conference room at the company's San Francisco office. The device, reportedly wrapped in toilet paper, was discovered inserted into a USB port on the back of a television. Alfozan had been employed at OpenAI since June 2025 before his arrest.

timeline.title: Former OpenAI Employee Allegedly Received Saudi Support in Device Planting Case
timeline.summary: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a former OpenAI employee, is accused of planting a device and allegedly received support from Saudi sources. US prosecutors claim he was in frequent communication with an unnamed member of the Saudi Royal family and that a Saudi military member funded a one-way plane ticket for Alfozan's wife and son to return to Saudi Arabia.
